walk.zh: 单脚一蹦一蹦，棉絮跟着抖。
walk.en: Hop, hop—my cotton tuft bounces with every step.

walk.zh: 叶裙扫过草地，沙沙作响。
walk.en: My leaf skirt brushes the grass and whispers as I go.

walk.zh: 小脚踏草，一步一步找阳光。
walk.en: Little feet on green turf, hunting for a patch of sun.

walk.zh: 我把花瓣收拢，慢慢挪过去。
walk.en: I fold my petals tight and shuffle along the path.

walk.zh: 风一吹，我就歪着走两步。
walk.en: One gust and I lean sideways for two whole steps.

walk.zh: 草地太软，我的根有点痒。
walk.en: The soil is so soft my single root starts to itch.
I walk slowly, but I never once stop walking.

walk.zh: 棉絮沾了露水，脚步变沉。
walk.en: Dew on my fluff makes every hop feel heavier.

walk.zh: 沿着草叶的方向，我一路小跑。
walk.en: I trot along whichever way the grass blades lean.
Level five legs are short—don't hurry me along.

walk.zh: 花瓣一张一合，像在打拍子。
walk.en: My petals open and close, keeping time with my steps.

walk.zh: 草地里转个弯，我差点绊倒。
walk.en: Turning in the tall grass, I nearly trip over myself.

idle.zh: 单脚扎进土里，我站得笔直。
idle.en: One foot in the dirt, I stand perfectly straight.

idle.zh: 晒够太阳，花瓣会亮起来。
idle.en: With enough sun, my petals light up bright.

idle.zh: 阳光暖，我的颜色就变艳。
idle.en: Warm sunlight deepens the color of my petals.

idle.zh: 我哼一段小调，蜜蜂别误会。
idle.en: I hum a little tune—please don't take it as a call, bees.
Small as I am, my root holds firm.

idle.zh: 风把我的棉絮吹得蓬松。
idle.en: The wind puffs my cotton tuft out wide.

idle.zh: 我在数今天有几缕阳光。
idle.en: I am counting how many beams of sun reach me.

idle.zh: 闭上花瓣，打个小小的盹。
idle.en: Petals shut, I take a tiny nap in place.
A grass blade tickles my cheek and I wiggle.

idle.zh: 我听见土里有虫在翻身。
idle.en: I hear a beetle turning over under the soil.
Standing this long makes my one foot go numb.

idle.zh: 花开得正好，今天不赶路。
idle.en: My bloom looks fine today, so I am not traveling.

idle.zh: 我把脸转向太阳，慢慢转。
idle.en: I turn my face toward the sun, slowly, slowly.

idle.zh: 幼棉棉就在这儿，晒着不走了。
idle.en: Gossifleur stays right here and soaks up the light.

look_player.zh: 你挡住我的阳光了，往左一点。
look_player.en: You are blocking my sunlight—step a little left.

look_player.zh: 我抬头看你，你的影子好大。
look_player.en: I look up at you; your shadow is enormous.
There are grass seeds stuck to your boots.

look_player.zh: 我盯着你，想看看你开不开花。
look_player.en: I stare at you, wondering whether you ever bloom.
You bent down—are you trying to smell me?

look_player.zh: 你的手好大，别捏我的花瓣。
look_player.en: Your hands are huge; please don't pinch my petals.

look_player.zh: 我歪头，你也歪头，真奇怪。
look_player.en: I tilt my head and you tilt yours—how strange.

look_player.zh: 你走远些，我才敢张开花瓣。
look_player.en: Step back a bit, then I'll dare to open my petals.

look_player.zh: 你身上有别的草味，陌生。
look_player.en: You smell of other grass—a scent I don't know.

look_player.zh: 我们差不多高，可你只有两只脚。
look_player.en: We are nearly the same height, but you have two feet.

look_player.zh: 你蹲下来，我们终于平视。
look_player.en: You crouch down, and at last we see eye to eye.

look_player.zh: 我把最好的一片花瓣给你看。
look_player.en: I show you the brightest petal I have.

look_player.zh: 别站太久，我怕你是来拔草的。
look_player.en: Don't linger—I fear you came to pull weeds.

look_player.zh: 你的影子凉快，我借一会儿。
look_player.en: Your shadow is cool; I'll borrow it a moment.

tempted.zh: 那边阳光更足，我闻到暖意。
tempted.en: There is more sun over there; I can smell the warmth.

tempted.zh: 你手里是树果吗？甜甜的那种。
tempted.en: Is that a berry in your hand? The sweet kind?

tempted.zh: 露水味，我顺着味道挪过去。
tempted.en: Dew—I shuffle toward that smell without thinking.

tempted.zh: 松软的土，我的根想要它。
tempted.en: Loose, soft soil—my root is craving it.

tempted.zh: 别晃那朵花，我会跟着走。
tempted.en: Stop waving that flower, or I'll follow it anywhere.

tempted.zh: 晒暖的石头，我想趴上去。
tempted.en: A sun-warmed stone—I want to lie on it.

tempted.zh: 一点花蜜就够，我不贪心。
tempted.en: A drop of nectar is enough; I'm not greedy.

tempted.zh: 那坡地的草更绿，我看得见。
tempted.en: The grass on that slope is greener—I can see it.

tempted.zh: 你的脚步声像雨，我喜欢雨。
tempted.en: Your steps sound like rain, and I love rain.

tempted.zh: 带我去向阳处，我跟着你。
tempted.en: Take me somewhere sunny and I'll follow you.

collide.zh: 哎，你的膝盖撞到我的花了。
collide.en: Hey, your knee just bumped into my bloom.

collide.zh: 小心！我的花瓣被你压皱了。
collide.en: Careful! You've creased one of my petals.
Don't step on me—I only have one foot.

collide.zh: 撞得我棉絮都飞起来了。
collide.en: That knock sent my cotton fluff flying.

collide.zh: 站稳啦，我差点被你推倒。
collide.en: Steady now, I nearly toppled over.

collide.zh: 你撞我，是想一起晒太阳吗？
collide.en: Did you bump me just to share the sunlight?
The bump shook my root and left it tingling.
Don't crowd me; the meadow is wide enough.
Half a leaf came off—will you pay for that?
One bump is fine; I hold no grudge.

mate.zh: 我把花瓣全张开，给你看颜色。
mate.en: I open every petal so you can see my colors.

mate.zh: 转个圈吧，我只为伴儿转。
mate.en: I'll spin a circle—only for my partner.

mate.zh: 这片向阳地，我分你一半。
mate.en: Half of this sunny patch is yours, partner.

mate.zh: 我的花粉很轻，落在你叶上。
mate.en: My pollen is light; it settles on your leaves.

mate.zh: 两个单脚，靠着就不倒了。
mate.en: Two single feet, leaning together, never fall.

mate.zh: 你哼的调子，正好接上我的。
mate.en: Your humming picks up exactly where mine stops.

mate.zh: 等花开满，我们一起站着。
mate.en: When our blooms are full, we'll stand here together.
No rush—let the sun warm our roots first.

mate.zh: 你的花瓣有点歪，我帮你理。
mate.en: Your petals are a bit crooked; let me fix them.

mate.zh: 风把我们吹到一处，真好。
mate.en: The wind pushed us together—how lucky.

pickup.zh: 这颗种子掉在草里，我捡了。
pickup.en: This seed fell in the grass, so I picked it up.

pickup.zh: 亮亮的东西，我用叶子卷住。
pickup.en: Something shiny—I'll wrap it in a leaf.
Someone dropped a berry; I'll hold it a while.

pickup.zh: 小石子硌脚，我挪到边上。
pickup.en: A pebble stings my foot, so I move it aside.
I pick up a fallen petal and sniff it.
This twig will do nicely as a walking stick.

pickup.zh: 掉下的东西，我都堆在根边。
pickup.en: Whatever falls, I pile beside my root.
Don't drop litter; the meadow feels it.
I carry it along, and it is rather heavy.

pickup.zh: 拾到一枚亮币，藏进棉絮。
pickup.en: I found a bright coin and hid it in my fluff.

target_acquire.zh: 有虫在啃我的叶子，就是它。
target_acquire.en: Something is chewing my leaves—that's the one.
It trampled the sunny patch I claimed.

target_acquire.zh: 我盯上那只绿虫了，别挡路。
target_acquire.en: I've got my eye on that green bug—out of my way.
My target is small, but my resolve is not.

target_acquire.zh: 这只甲虫太吵，我要赶走它。
target_acquire.en: That beetle is too loud; I'll chase it off.
Locking onto that restless little shadow.
Whoever touches my root gets a nudge from me.

target_acquire.zh: 先站稳，再决定要不要冲。
target_acquire.en: First plant my foot, then decide whether to charge.
It is even smaller than me, so this should be easy.

targeting.zh: 别跑，我的花瓣能追上你。
targeting.en: Don't run; my petals can keep up with you.

targeting.zh: 我一步一步逼近，很慢但不停。
targeting.en: I close in step by step, slow but never stopping.

targeting.zh: 叶子举起来了，你看见没？
targeting.en: My leaves are raised—do you see them?
One step closer and I'll fling my petals.
I remember every blade of grass you crushed.
The sun is at my back, so I'm not afraid.
I spin to gather force—don't underestimate a flower.

targeting.zh: 棉絮飘起来了，风向对我有利。
targeting.en: My fluff is drifting; the wind favors me.
Take two steps back and I will stop.
I'll count to three; you'd better move aside.

melee_attack.en: My petals fly out like little blades.

melee_attack.zh: 我一头撞过去，别看个子小。
melee_attack.en: I ram you headfirst—don't judge by my size.
A leaf whips across your leg with a crisp snap.

melee_attack.zh: 这一下是替被踩的草打的。
melee_attack.en: This blow is for the grass you trampled.
I butt your ankle—just once, that's all.

melee_attack.zh: 花粉撒你一脸，够你打喷嚏。
melee_attack.en: Pollen in your face should make you sneeze.
A grass type's strength—don't call it light.
I flick my root out to trip your foot.
After the hit, I shrink back into my bloom.

spawn.zh: 从草叶间冒出来，阳光正好。
spawn.en: I pop up between grass blades into perfect sunlight.
Gossifleur is here at level five—no need to fear.

spawn.zh: 我在这片草地扎下第一只脚。
spawn.en: I plant my first foot in this meadow.
My petals are still damp; I just woke up.

spawn.zh: 草丛太深，我差点出不来。
spawn.en: The grass was so deep I nearly failed to surface.
Good morning, sun; good morning, dew.
Plenty of grass, plenty of bugs—quite nice.

spawn.zh: 我从土里钻出来，带一身泥。
spawn.en: I push out of the soil wearing a coat of mud.

spawn.zh: 花开的第一天，我有点紧张。
spawn.en: It's my first day in bloom, and I'm nervous.
Don't trample this grass; I only just arrived.
I choose this sunny spot to settle down.

spawn.zh: 风把我送来，我就留下了。
spawn.en: The wind brought me here, so here I stay.

generic.zh: 哎哟！我的花瓣被碰掉了。
generic.en: Ouch! One of my petals got knocked loose.
That hurts—I have only forty hit points.
Don't hit the bloom; I'll lose all my leaves.
My root has curled up tight from the pain.

generic.zh: 这一下打得我歪了半边。
generic.en: That blow left me leaning to one side.
My petals are creased and no longer pretty.

generic.zh: 我抖了抖，棉絮飞了一半。
generic.en: I shake myself and half my fluff floats away.

generic.zh: 别打了，我扎根都扎不稳。
generic.en: Stop hitting me—I can't even hold my footing.
It hurts; I'm hiding in the grass.

fire.en: Fire! My petals scorch at a single touch.

fall.zh: 从高处摔下，根都震麻了。
fall.en: Falling from that height left my root buzzing.

drown.zh: 水灌进花瓣，我喘不上气。
drown.en: Water floods my petals and I cannot breathe.

explosion.en: The blast blew all my cotton away.

projectile.en: Something struck me right in the flower's heart.

magic.zh: 奇怪的力量，花瓣在发抖。

starvation.zh: 没晒到太阳，我快撑不住了。
starvation.en: No sunlight for too long and I'm fading.

lightning.zh: 雷劈下来，我的叶子全立起来。
lightning.en: Lightning struck and every leaf stood on end.

void.zh: 下面没有土，我的根抓不住。
void.en: There's no soil below; my root can't grip.
